breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still contains both 'gamma-centered' and 'half shift in all directions' in the same instruction ('Use a gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift in all directions'), which perpetuates the original contradiction. The ground truth resolves this by specifying only a gamma-centered k-point grid with no mention of a half shift. The agent failed to remove the conflicting half-shift instruction.
